funktionen.meta.title: Features – Gregor Zwanzig
funktionen.meta.description: All features of Gregor Zwanzig at a glance: trips and location comparisons, briefings, alerts, four channels, reply commands and the levels Free, Standard and Premium.
funktionen.lead: Gregor Zwanzig is a weather service for multi-day hikes. Here you find all main features sorted by topic, with pictures of the real interface and real messages.
funktionen.schritte.eins.text: Name the route, add stages with dates and upload one GPX file per stage.
funktionen.schritte.zwei.text: Email, Telegram, SMS or Premium-SMS: set which channel gets briefings and which gets alerts.
funktionen.schritte.drei.titel: Briefings and alerts on the trail
funktionen.schritte.drei.text: Every morning and evening the weather for your stage arrives, in between an alert when something changes.

funktionen.navigation.label: Topics of the feature overview

funktionen.cta.text: Sign-up is open and starts on the Free level. With an account you create your first trip.
funktionen.verfuegbar.label: Available in:
funktionen.seite.trips.kachel: Create stages with GPX, see everything in the cockpit and find finished trips in the archive.
funktionen.seite.trips.einleitung: A trip is your multi-day hike with its stages. Gregor works out when you are at which point and fetches the weather for exactly that.
funktionen.seite.trips.beschreibung: Planning trips with Gregor Zwanzig: stages with GPX, walking times from your pace, cockpit, trip overview and archive.
funktionen.seite.briefings.kachel: The weather per stage section every morning and evening, with values and thresholds of your choice.
funktionen.seite.briefings.einleitung: The briefing is the regular message with the weather for your stage: in the morning for today, in the evening for tomorrow.
funktionen.seite.briefings.beschreibung: Weather briefings from Gregor Zwanzig: hourly table per stage section, three-day outlook, templates, weather values and thresholds in the Weather tab.
funktionen.seite.alarme.kachel: Weather changes, early signs, official warnings and rain radar between the briefings.
funktionen.seite.alarme.einleitung: Between briefings Gregor gets in touch when the weather for your route changes in a relevant way or an authority issues a warning.
funktionen.seite.alarme.beschreibung: Alerts from Gregor Zwanzig: weather changes with all-clear, early signs of thunderstorms and heavy rain, official warnings and rain radar.
funktionen.seite.ortsvergleich.kachel: Several locations side by side in one table, as a scheduled briefing.
funktionen.seite.ortsvergleich.einleitun: The location comparison shows the weather of several locations side by side, for example for possible weekend destinations.
funktionen.seite.ortsvergleich.beschreib: Location comparison in Gregor Zwanzig: the weather of several locations in one comparison table without ranking, as a briefing and with alerts.
funktionen.seite.kanaele.kachel: Email, Telegram, SMS and Premium-SMS via Garmin inReach, with times and urgency per channel.
funktionen.seite.kanaele.einleitung: Gregor delivers over four equal channels. In the Delivery tab you set when what arrives over which channel.
funktionen.seite.kanaele.beschreibung: Channels of Gregor Zwanzig: email, Telegram, SMS and Premium-SMS via Garmin inReach, times, urgency and quiet hours in the Delivery tab.
funktionen.seite.befehle.kachel: Reply to get the weather, pause briefings or shift stages.
funktionen.seite.befehle.einleitung: You can reply to every briefing with a short command, even without internet on the trail via Premium-SMS.
funktionen.seite.befehle.beschreibung: Reply commands of Gregor Zwanzig: get the weather, pause briefings, shift stages, by email, Telegram and Premium-SMS.
funktionen.seite.wetterdaten.kachel: The finest available weather model per region, plus radar for the next hours.
funktionen.seite.wetterdaten.einleitung: For every point of your route Gregor takes the weather model with the finest resolution available for the region.
funktionen.seite.wetterdaten.beschreibun: Weather data in Gregor Zwanzig: model choice per region via Open-Meteo, further weather services and short-range radar data.
funktionen.seite.konto.kachel: Language, level, sign-in with passkey or link, data export and use as an app.
funktionen.seite.konto.einleitung: In your account you set language and sign-in and see your level. On your phone Gregor works like an app.
funktionen.seite.konto.beschreibung: Your Gregor Zwanzig account: language German or English, level and request, passkey, sign-in link, data export, use as an app and offline.
funktionen.seite.level.kachel: What each level includes and how to request another level.
funktionen.seite.level.einleitung: Every account has a level. It sets how many trips, location comparisons and locations you can create and which channels are available.
funktionen.seite.level.beschreibung: The levels Free, Standard and Premium of Gregor Zwanzig: limits for trips, location comparisons, locations, SMS, Premium-SMS and alerts per day.
funktionen.level.text: “unlimited” means no daily limit. Email and Telegram are included on every level.
funktionen.level.wechsel.text: Open sign-up starts you on the Free level. You request another level in your account; the operator reviews the request and activates the level.
funktionen.cockpit.text: After signing in, the cockpit shows your trips and location comparisons at a glance: which trip is running, when the next briefing is sent and which alerts came in recently. A ready-to-go checklist shows what a new trip still lacks.
funktionen.trip_anlegen.text: A new trip takes a few steps: name the route, add stages with dates, upload one GPX file per stage and check the waypoints. From your walking pace Gregor calculates the walking times and so the hour at which you reach each point.
funktionen.trip_hub.text: Every trip has four tabs: Overview, Stages, Weather and Delivery. From here you send a briefing right away or archive the trip.
funktionen.archiv.text: When a trip has ended, it moves to the archive automatically. From there you can reactivate it or delete it for good.
funktionen.trips.verfuegbar: Free, Standard and Premium; how many active trips are possible depends on the level.
funktionen.briefings.text: In the morning you get the weather for the day's stage (preset 07:00), in the evening the weather for tomorrow's stage (preset 18:00). The email contains an hourly table per stage section and an outlook on the next three days.
funktionen.briefings.text2: Telegram, SMS and Premium-SMS bring the same content in a shorter form: Telegram detailed or in compact style, SMS and Premium-SMS as a compact line with abbreviations.
funktionen.wetter.titel: Weather tab: what the briefing contains
funktionen.wetter.text: In the Weather tab you pick a template, for example alpine trekking, or put the values together yourself: which weather values, in which order and in which short form. For each value you set from when it counts as yellow, orange or red (“alert from”).
funktionen.wetter.text2: The table “What goes where” shows per channel which value appears where; a preview shows the result. You save your own templates in your account.
funktionen.alarme.text: Between briefings Gregor sends an alert when the weather for your route changes in a relevant way, and an all-clear when it calms down again. Early signs announce the onset of thunderstorms or heavy rain.
funktionen.alarme.text2: Official warnings arrive as alerts too, with all-clear: Météo-France Vigilance, Meteoalarm, GeoSphere Austria, DWD, the Italian civil protection (DPC), avalanche bulletins from SLF, closures of mountain massifs and forest fire danger.
funktionen.alarme.text3: For the next hours a rain radar checks whether rain is moving towards your route. Alerts go out over all channels you selected for them in the Delivery tab.
funktionen.alarme.verfuegbar: Free, Standard and Premium; how many proactive alerts arrive per day depends on the level.
funktionen.ortsvergleich.text: In a location comparison you put two or more locations side by side, for example possible destinations for a weekend. Gregor shows the values in a comparison table without ranking and sends it as a briefing on a schedule. Alerts are available here too, on all four channels.
funktionen.ortsvergleich.text2: You manage your locations in a list of their own and use them in as many location comparisons as you like. Weather values, delivery times and channels are set up just like for a trip.
funktionen.ortsvergleich.verfuegbar: Free, Standard and Premium; how many location comparisons and locations are possible depends on the level.
funktionen.kanaele.text: On the trail you cannot predict what gets through. That is why Gregor delivers over four equal channels with the same content: email with tables, Telegram detailed or in compact style, SMS as a short line of up to 160 characters and Premium-SMS to a Garmin inReach via satellite with up to 153 characters.
funktionen.kanaele.text2: SMS needs a confirmed number, Premium-SMS a link code for the device. In your account you can check each channel with a test message, and a display shows how much of the daily quota has been used.
funktionen.kanaele.verfuegbar: Email and Telegram in Free, Standard and Premium; SMS in Standard and Premium; Premium-SMS in Premium.
funktionen.zustellung.titel: Delivery tab: when and where to
funktionen.zustellung.text: In the Delivery tab you set the briefing times and the period and choose per channel whether it gets briefings, alerts or both.
funktionen.zustellung.text2: Each channel has an urgency threshold, for example SMS only from medium and Premium-SMS only at high urgency. There are also quiet hours and a minimum gap between two alerts. If a channel is blocked, the reason is shown next to it.
funktionen.befehle.text: You can reply to a briefing with a command, for example to get tomorrow's weather or to pause briefings. The commands exist in German and English.
funktionen.befehle.kanaele: Commands arrive by email, Telegram and Premium-SMS. Normal SMS is receive only, Gregor does not process replies to it.
funktionen.befehle.ortsvergleich: For a location comparison only pause, resume and help apply.
funktionen.wetterdaten.titel: Where the weather data comes from
funktionen.wetterdaten.text: Per region Gregor picks the finest available weather model via Open-Meteo: AROME (1.3 km) for France and the Balearic Islands, ICON-D2 (2 km) for the Alps and Germany, MetNo Nordic (1 km) for Scandinavia, ICON-EU (7 km) for Europe and ECMWF worldwide.
funktionen.wetterdaten.text2: On top come data from DWD, Bright Sky, GeoSphere Austria and Météo-France. For the next hours Gregor uses radar and short-range data (RADOLAN, INCA, ICON-2I, AROME-HD). Every briefing names the data source and model at the end.
funktionen.konto.text: In your account you choose the language (German or English), see your level including a request for another level, and how many trips, location comparisons and locations you have created.
funktionen.konto.text2: You can sign in with a password, a passkey, a sign-in link by email or with Google. You can export your data and delete your account yourself.
funktionen.app.text: Gregor can be installed on your phone like an app. Without a connection it shows the overview with the last loaded state; saving changes works again once you are back online.
